reference_sql:
SELECT category_id, category_name
FROM categories
WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE brand = 'Cablemate')
alternatives:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id
    AND p.brand = 'Cablemate'
)

SELECT DISTINCT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Cablemate'

other_way.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Cablemate'
other_way.tradeoff: A join with DISTINCT gives the same categories, but repeats each one per product until DISTINCT removes the copies.
